Errors.CANCELLED: Confirmation was cancelled on your device. You can try again.
Errors.PASSKEY_EXISTS: This manager already has a GatoPago key. Use another manager or a security key.
Errors.PASSKEY_WITHOUT_PRF: This device or this key does not work with GatoPago. Use your phone, with the key saved in iCloud or Google, or a security key.
Errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: That key does not belong to a GatoPago account. If you are new, create an account.
Errors.INVITE_REQUIRED: You need an invitation to create an account.
Errors.TURNSTILE_REQUIRED: Confirm it is you to activate your account again.
Errors.INVITE_INVALID: This invitation is unavailable. Check the code.
Errors.TURNSTILE_FAILED: We could not validate the security check. Try again.
Errors.TURNSTILE_UNAVAILABLE: The security check did not finish. Check your connection and try again.
Errors.INVALID_SOCIAL_URL: Use an https link from Instagram, X, Telegram, TikTok or Facebook.
Errors.INVALID_USERNAME: Use 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores, starting with a letter.
Errors.SPONSORSHIP_LIMIT_REACHED: You reached the daily limit of free operations. Come back tomorrow.
Errors.STELLAR_TRANSACTION_PENDING: Your operation is still in progress. Check Activity in a moment before repeating it.
Errors.INSUFFICIENT_COIN: You do not have enough of that coin.
Errors.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Your balance is not enough. If it is spread across networks, gather it in “Between networks”.
Errors.INVALID_ADDRESS: Invalid address: it must be a valid 0x address.
Errors.INVALID_STELLAR_ADDRESS: Invalid Stellar address: it must start with G or C.
Errors.STELLAR_RECIPIENT_CANNOT_RECEIVE: That Stellar account does not accept USDC yet: it must add USDC (a trustline) first.
Errors.STELLAR_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: That Stellar account does not exist or is not active yet: it cannot receive XLM.
Errors.STELLAR_SIGNER_PENDING: This device key does not sign on Stellar yet. Sync it in Security from a device that already does.
Errors.NOT_AN_OWNER: That key does not own your account.
Errors.STELLAR_ACCOUNT_WITHOUT_SIGNERS: Your account has no key that can sign on Stellar. Add a backup key in Security.
Errors.STELLAR_RELAY_REJECTED: GatoPago could not deliver this transfer on Stellar. Your funds remain with Circle: contact us.
Errors.BALANCE_ON_OTHER_NETWORK: Your balance on this network is not enough. Gather it here from your other networks in “Between networks”.
Errors.CCTP_FEE_UNAVAILABLE: We could not get the cross-network fee. Try again in a moment.
Errors.CCTP_AMOUNT_BELOW_FEE: The amount is below the cross-network fee.
Errors.DUPLICATE_RECIPIENT: Someone appears twice: put their amounts in a single row.
Errors.APPROVAL_PENDING: The change is saved but still pending on some networks: check each one below. It completes on your next operation there.
Errors.OPERATION_PENDING: Your previous operation is still in progress. Check Activity in a moment before repeating it.
Errors.GROUPS_FULL: You already have 20 saved groups. Delete one to save another.
Errors.PAYMENT_NOT_REGISTERED: Your payment went through, but we could not tell the merchant. Try again: you will not be charged twice.
Errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Nothing was sent: your browser does not let GatoPago store data on this site, and we need it so a payment never goes out twice. Allow site storage (or leave private browsing) and try again.
Errors.PREVIOUS_OPERATION_CONFIRMED: Your previous operation went through. Check Activity before sending it again.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.
Errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
Errors.NETWORK_ERROR: GatoPago cannot be reached. Try again.
Errors.UNKNOWN: We could not complete this step. Try again.
Errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This account is already active. Tap Sign in again.
